messages:
Maya: Quick question — for the new per-model micro-cost sparkline on the Console, should the sparkline show gross token spend or net after cache savings? We need to decide sampling and attribution before implementation. @Jordan @Sam
Jordan: I'd prefer net after cache savings; product wants user-facing unit-econ. But surface raw somewhere for debuggability.
Sam: Net makes sense. How accurate does net need to be? Telemetry sampling is 1% currently.
Maya: If we sample, cache crediting math gets fuzzy. Options: 1) estimate net via heuristic (prefetch credits allocated proportionally), 2) compute exact for sampled traces only and show CI, 3) calculate net in coarse buckets. Thoughts?
Leah: Option 2 + show a confidence band is my vote. UX can display 95% CI for each sparkline point.
Jordan: Also remember per-model SKUs vary — unit_token_price depends on quantization and slot type.
Sam: Telemetry: we can emit a cheap micro-aggregation in the batcher: per-request gross_tokens, cache_savings, model_sku.
Dev-bot: deploy triggered: telemetry/aggregators -> experiment/mini-cost-metrics :rocket:
Maya: For sampling, compute exact nets on 0.1% traces, then expand via weighted estimator for the totals.
Jordan: 0.1% might be noisy for low-volume models. UI should default to "net (estimated)" and let users toggle to "gross + cache credits" raw view.
Leah: Also add a per-model tag 'cache-susceptible' if prefix cache hitrate > 20% so product can filter.
Maya: Action items: Sam prototype aggregator metric (Wed), Jordan mock UI copy + hover explaining sampling & CI, Leah propose threshold. I'll open a short RFC.
Sam: ack
Jordan: ack
Leah: ack
Maya: Pseudocode for aggregator query:
```
SELECT model, sum(tokens * unit_price) AS gross, sum(cache_saved) AS cache, sum(tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM micro_metrics
SAMPLE 0.001
GROUP BY model
```
Sam: tweak: compute effective_token_cost = (gross - cache) / total_tokens
Maya: Perfect — thanks. Sync Thu 10am in #eng-platform.
